title: Transferring a service lead to sales
objective: Identify, qualify, and transfer new business opportunities found by Service to Sales, to improve customer experience, drive system upgrades, and convert leads.
scope: All service staff (technicians, coordinators, managers) and the sales team handling upgrades, replacements, or expansions. Residential and commercial customers.

responsibilities.responsibility: Identify and document leads during service interactions.
Review and approve qualified leads before forwarding to Sales.
Receive Desk tickets, assign leads to a rep, monitor status, track performance.
Follow up promptly, update CRM, pursue the opportunity.

trigger: During a service visit, a technician finds a potential upgrade, replacement, or expansion opportunity.

procedure.if: the part is end-of-life, faulty, or unreliable AND a like-for-like upgrade fixes it without changing the rest of the system
the customer is residential AND the equipment is outdated/obsolete
new or improved parts, platforms, or technologies could be sold
the system is obsolete AND cannot be replaced without a formal quote

procedure.text: Step 2 - Submit the lead in Zoho Desk:
Create or update a ticket titled “Potential Sales Lead - [Customer Name].”
In comments, record: reason for referral, system condition / upgrade potential, site location, contact info.
Convert to Lead and assign to the VP of Sales for distribution.

procedure.if: the lead is discovered before 5 PM
procedure.then: contact the customer the same day.

procedure.text: Log all activity in Zoho CRM. Track status: Contacted → In Discussion → Quoted → Closed-Won / Closed-Lost.
Sales updates Zoho Desk and CRM. The VP of Sales provides monthly lead-performance metrics at the Sales/Service review.

done_when: Lead is logged in Zoho Desk with reason, system condition, and site/contact; converted and assigned to the VP of Sales; and Sales has logged first contact in Zoho CRM (same day, or next morning if after 5 PM).
records: Sales lead ticket (the Service-to-Sales handoff record) - Zoho Desk
Lead record and activity log - Zoho CRM

revision_log.change: Recast into the AAC template; Step 1 as IF/THEN; added Trigger and Done-when
